worldcombat.skill.wakeupslap.summary: A heavy open-hand slam thrown with a full lunge: double damage against a sleeping target, and the hit wakes it up (leaving it briefly dazed and slowed, but still able to fight back). The slap only strikes the one body it actually hits.
worldcombat.skill.wakeupslap.description: This palm deals about %1$s contact damage; against a sleeping target it doubles and wakes the target up.
Lunge %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick, collision radius %3$s blocks, shove %4$s blocks.
A woken target is briefly dazed and slowed for %1$s (only a slow; it can still fight back).
worldcombat.skill.wakeupslap.use.1: Double damage in the sleep window
worldcombat.skill.wakeupslap.use.2: Cash the doubled hit before the target wakes
Only close in when the target is within this distance; higher chases sleeping targets further out.
On: prioritize sleeping targets for the doubled-power hit; but this slap wakes them, possibly buying them a turn right away. Off: keep the ordinary low priority without weighting sleep.
worldcombat.skill.wakeupslap.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s, recover %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.wakeupslap.growth.0: From level %1$s: slam power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.wakeupslap.growth.1: From level %1$s: slam power %2$s, lunge distance %3$s.
